title: Article 6 — Classification rules for high-risk AI systems
text: Annex III systems are high-risk, subject to Article 6(3)'s conditions and exceptions concerning significant risk and material influence on decision-making.

title: Annex III — Employment, workers' management and access to self-employment
text: Annex III point 4(a) covers AI systems intended for recruitment or selection, including analysing and filtering job applications and evaluating candidates.

title: Article 14 — Human oversight
text: High-risk AI systems must be designed so they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during use.

title: Article 14 — Human ability to override AI output
text: Human oversight measures must enable natural persons, where appropriate, to disregard, override or reverse the output of a high-risk AI system.

title: Article 50 — AI interaction transparency
text: Providers must generally ensure that people interacting directly with an AI system are informed that they are interacting with AI, unless that is obvious.
